# Browse files and folders
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Find a file or folder in the repository of the selected workspace.

## Browse the folder tree
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->

1. Select a workspace that is a Git repository, a project folder whose changes Git records.
2. Click **Files**, the first folder icon in the sidebar icon bar at the outer edge of the left sidebar.
3. Click a folder row to unfold the folder.
4. Unfold any folders inside the folder until the file or folder you need appears.

## Refresh the folder tree
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->


1. Click **Refresh**, the circular-arrow button in the Files header.
2. Check the folder tree for the updated files and folders.

## Fold all folders
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->


1. Click **Collapse all folders**, the square containing a minus sign in the Files header.
2. Click an individual folder row to unfold the folder again.

After **Collapse all folders**, the tree shows the top-level rows with their folders folded.

## Troubleshooting
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

### “Select a workspace.” appears

**Cause**: No workspace is selected.

**Solution**:

1. Select a workspace that is a Git repository.

**Check**: The Files sidebar section shows the folder tree instead of the message.

### “This workspace is not a Git repository.” appears

**Cause**: The selected workspace is not a Git repository.

**Solution**:

1. Select a workspace that is a Git repository.

**Check**: The folder tree appears.

### Refresh is temporarily disabled

**Cause**: Heidrun is loading the file list.

**Solution**:

1. Wait for the file list to finish loading.
2. Click **Refresh** if you still need to update the list.

**Check**: **Refresh** becomes available when loading finishes.

# Change the Files list appearance
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Adjust the spacing and folder-level guide lines in the Files sidebar section.

## Change indentation
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->

1. Open **Files** using the first folder icon in the sidebar icon bar at the outer edge of the left sidebar.
2. Click **More options**, the three vertical dots at the right of the Files header.
3. Under **Indentation**, choose **Small**, **Medium**, or **Large** to change the spacing between folder levels.

## Change row height
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->

1. Reopen **More options**.
2. Under **Row height**, choose **Compact** for closer rows or **Comfortable** for more space between rows.

## Show or hide indent guides
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->

Indent guides are vertical lines that show the folder levels.

1. Reopen **More options**.
2. Under **Indent guides**, choose **Show** or **Hide**.

## Check the appearance
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->


1. Check the folder tree for the changed spacing and guide lines.
2. Reopen **More options** to check the check mark beside each saved choice.

- [Browse files and folders](/documentation/browse_files): to find a file or folder.

# Copy a file path
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Copy a file path in the form needed by another application or a terminal.

## Copy a file path
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->

1. Find the file in the Files sidebar section, unfolding the containing folders as needed.
2. Right-click the file row to open the small menu at the pointer.
3. Choose **Copy absolute path** for the full location of the file on your computer, or **Copy relative path** for the location starting from the workspace folder.
4. Check the message showing the copied path.
5. Paste the path into the application or terminal where you need the path.

## Troubleshooting
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->


### The path-copy menu does not appear on a folder row

**Cause**: The path-copy menu belongs only to file rows.

**Solution**:

1. Unfold the folder containing the file you need.
2. Right-click the file row.

**Check**: The menu shows **Copy absolute path** and **Copy relative path**.

# Create a file or folder
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Create an empty file or folder in a chosen location in the repository.

## Choose the destination folder
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->

1. Select the workspace containing the repository.
2. Click **Files**, the first folder icon in the sidebar icon bar at the outer edge of the left sidebar.
3. Choose the destination using one of these actions:

| Destination | Action |
| --- | --- |
| A folder in the tree | Click the folder row. |
| The folder containing a file | Click the file row. |
| The repository root, the top folder of the repository | Click empty space outside the rows in the Files sidebar section. |

## Create a file or folder
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->

1. Click **New file**, the first header button showing a file with a plus sign, or **New folder**, the second header button showing a folder with a plus sign.
2. Type only the new name in the name box that appears at the start of the destination folder's contents.
3. Press **Enter**.

The new row becomes selected. A new file also opens in the large Git window.

## Cancel creation
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->


1. Press **Escape** while the name box is open, or click outside the name box.

The name box closes without creating a file or folder.

## Troubleshooting
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

### “A name cannot contain the character /. Select a folder first.” appears

**Cause**: The name contains `/`, which cannot be used to specify a folder in the name box.

**Solution**:

1. Press **Escape** to cancel creation.
2. Select the destination folder in the tree.
3. Click **New file** or **New folder** again.
4. Type a name without `/`.
5. Press **Enter**.

**Check**: The new row appears in the destination folder and is selected.

### An existing-name error appears and the name box stays open

**Cause**: A file or folder with the entered name already exists in the destination folder.

**Solution**:

1. Replace the name in the name box with a name that is not already used in the destination folder.
2. Press **Enter**.

**Check**: The name box closes and the new row becomes selected.

# Files sidebar section
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: reference -->

Look up the contents, controls, and visible states of the Files sidebar section.

## Folder tree
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->

The folder tree shows the files tracked by Git and new files. Folders come before files, and both groups are in alphabetical order.

When the option to show ignored files is enabled, folders excluded by `.gitignore`, the repository's list of files and folders for Git to ignore, appear without contents that can be unfolded.

## Row indicators
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->

| Indicator | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Folder arrow | Shows whether a folder is folded or unfolded; ignored folders have no arrow. |
| Folder or file-kind icon | Identifies a folder or the kind of file. |
| Status letter at the right of a file row | Marks a changed file. |
| Dot at the right of a folder row | Marks a folder containing changes. |
| Outline around a row | Marks the selected file or folder. |

## Header buttons
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->

The header stays visible while the folder tree scrolls. The five buttons appear in this order from left to right.

| Button | Appearance | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **New file** | File with a plus sign | Opens a name box for an empty file in the selected folder, the selected file's folder, or the repository root when nothing is selected. |
| **New folder** | Folder with a plus sign | Opens a name box for an empty folder in the same destination choices as **New file**. |
| **Refresh** | Circular arrow | Updates the folder tree; disabled while the file list loads. |
| **Collapse all folders** | Square containing a minus sign | Folds every folder. |
| **More options** | Three vertical dots | Opens the list appearance choices. |

## More options
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->


| Group | Choices | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Indentation** | **Small**, **Medium**, **Large** | Spacing between folder levels. |
| **Row height** | **Compact**, **Comfortable** | Space occupied by each row. |
| **Indent guides** | **Show**, **Hide** | Visibility of the vertical lines showing folder levels. |

A check mark identifies the saved choice in each group.

## File path menu
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->


The menu at the pointer belongs to file rows; folder rows have no path-copy menu. A message shows the path after a copy.

| Menu item | Copied path |
| --- | --- |
| **Copy absolute path** | The full location of the file on your computer. |
| **Copy relative path** | The location of the file starting from the workspace folder. |

## Selection and folder state
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->

Each workspace has one selected row at most. Returning to a workspace restores the selected row with the containing folders unfolded.

The selected row remains selected when the large Git window closes or another sidebar section is shown. Folder folds are retained when changing sidebar sections.

## Empty folders and list limits
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

Newly created empty folders remain visible until Heidrun restarts. Folders removed outside Heidrun disappear after a refresh.

“The list is too long: only the first files are shown.” means that only part of the file list is displayed.

# Open a file
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

View a file from the Files sidebar section in the large Git window.

## Open a file from the Files sidebar section
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->

1. Select a workspace that is a Git repository.
2. Click **Files**, the first folder icon in the sidebar icon bar at the outer edge of the left sidebar.
3. Unfold the folders containing the file.
4. Click the file row.

The file opens in the large Git window.

## Troubleshooting
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->


### Diff and Side by side are disabled

**Cause**: The file has no changes to compare.

**Solution**:

1. Read the whole file already displayed in the large Git window.

**Check**: The file contents are visible without a comparison of changes.
